reviewNotes: Summon World is a social challenge platform for creating Quests with friends, submitting proof, and receiving an AI-assisted result. No real-money gambling is offered; credits are in-app points only and have no cash redemption value. App Review can create a normal email/password account or use the demo account supplied in App Store Connect. UGC moderation is available through Report content, Block a user, and support@summoner.world.
